title: Gideon and the Inheritance
author: Isandro Dunmore
blurb: Astrid Reyes, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
